protocol.feedback: autoregressive decoded RGB, deterministic VAE posterior mean

selection.criterion: At least two turning segments of six degrees, total turn >=25 degrees, endpoint error <=1.5 m and <=0.35 normalized, ATE <=1 m and <=0.25 normalized, and manual visual review of the full prediction.
selection.note: Curves are exact SE(2) integrations of the optimized model controls; no trajectory smoothing or ground-truth path substitution.
